## 6. Layout mechanics

Six mechanisms, each with its fix.

1. **Wrapped-element width** — a wrapper shrinks to content unless told otherwise.
2. **`minHeight` + centring** — reserves space without collapsing when empty.
3. **Inline descender leak** — an inline element's line box includes descender space; use
   `display: block` or set `lineHeight` explicitly.
4. **Gap ownership** — the parent owns the gap, never the child's margin. Two owners drift.
5. **`flexWrap: nowrap` prevents breaking, not shrinking** — the words break instead.
6. **NBSP as ` `** — a literal non-breaking space in source is invisible to review and
   survives reformatting unpredictably.

## 7. Building against absent data

### Three patterns, only the first correct

**Guard, then render inert but perceivable.** Never render nothing where a control was
promised; never render a control that can't act.

- **An empty-string fallback is a layout bug** — the box collapses and everything shifts.
- **A silent element swap actively lies** — it promises an affordance that isn't there.
- **Fix at the atom**, not at each call site.

### The three-tier policy — the most reusable decision in the footer build

Behaviour differs by what the content *is*:

| Content class | Behaviour | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Structural** (`footerConfig`) | render **nothing** — `if (!footerData) return null` | no fallback to placeholder once wired to live data, so an outage doesn't ship stale placeholder copy to real shoppers |
| **Microcopy** (`uiCopy`) | fall back to the **English literal** | losing a button label to an outage should never blank a control |
| **Per-item destination** (a contact href) | degrade **that item only** to a labelled non-interactive `<span>` | perceivable, but no false affordance |

The per-item case is the carefully argued one: no `href`, no `tabIndex`, so nothing promises an
action that cannot be performed (WCAG 2.4.4 / 3.2.4) — but **labelled, not `aria-hidden`**, so
a screen-reader user learns the channel exists instead of getting silence (avoiding the 1.1.1
information loss an earlier `aria-hidden` caused).

The same treatment is reused three times for "control with no action": the contact fallback,
`ZimmNavItem`'s no-href branch (renders a `<button>` that doesn't navigate), and `BottomBar`'s
locale placeholder (a `<div>`, deliberately not a `<button>`).

### Never branch on localised CMS text

`footerNavGroup` carries `showContactChannels: boolean` rather than matching
`heading === 'Contact'` — because `heading` is localised and silently stops matching the moment
an editor writes "Kontakt" or "Contacto". This footer ships to eight storefronts.

### Guarding hrefs

Every CMS-sourced href passes `isSafeHref` before reaching an anchor. The subtlety: WHATWG URL
parsing strips C0 control characters, tab, LF and CR *before* scheme detection, so a naive
`^javascript:` regex is bypassed by `java\tscript:`. **Normalise, then test.**

content.text:
I've verified all three documents against the repo. Here are the defects, most severe first.

## WRONG — factually incorrect

**1. `fedLead-playbook.md:601` — "the MuleSoft credentials … exist in no file"**
Claim: `ADYEN_HMAC_KEY`, `RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY`, `BOOXI_BASE_URL`, `GTM_SERVER_URL` and the MuleSoft credentials "exist in no file — they will never reach MRT."
Actual: `MULESOFT_BASE_URL` (`.env.sample:182`) and `MULESOFT_API_TOKEN` (`.env.sample:185`) both exist **and are tagged `# mrt:true`** (lines 181, 184) — by the doc's own stated mechanism they *would* sync. The other four keys are genuinely absent (0 hits in `.env.sample`), so only the MuleSoft item is inverted. This is the doc's highest-consequence error: it tells you a wired integration is unwired.

**2. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:98-101` / `fedBuild-manual.md:194` — "Measured on `develop`: 18 recipe files"**
Actual on `develop` @ `8362b3c`: **10** co-located `.css.ts` + 4 `theme/components/*` = **14**. The 18 (14+4) figure is the *current feature-branch working tree*, which adds four uncommitted-to-develop recipes (`zimmProductDescription`, `zimmProductPrice`, `zimmProductStyleCode`, `zimmProductContent`). Secondary: one of the "4 `theme/components/*.ts`" is `recipeGuards.test.ts` — a test file, not a recipe; only 3 recipes there. This is the measurement the whole "brand values don't belong in JSX" argument rests on, cited against the wrong ref.

**3. `fedLead-playbook.md:362` — "two spec files exist in the entire repo"**
Actual: **one**. `find` across the repo (excl. `node_modules`/`build`) returns only `e2e/tests/zimm/homepage/SMOKE-homepage-load.spec.js`, plus one matching `.feature`. `playwright.config.js:22`'s own comment says "the one spec file that exists today."

**4. `fedLead-playbook.md:180`, `fedBuild-manual.md:53`, `uiBuild-knowledge.md:304` — "208 base files import the barrel"**
Actual: **212** files under `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/` import `.../components/shared/ui'`. Alternatives: 196 excluding `.test.`, 195 excluding anything "test", 187 `.jsx`-only, 211 `.jsx`+`.js`. No methodology reaches 208. The load-bearing half — **0** files import an individual `shared/ui/<Name>` module — is correct.

**5. `fedLead-playbook.md:446-447` / `uiBuild-knowledge.md:663` — "squadA's 18 territory paths"**
Actual: `squadA.md`'s territory block (lines 33-53) lists **21** paths; its frontmatter `paths:` globs (lines 3-21) list **19**. Neither is 18. "4 exist" is correct (`pages/home/`, `pages/product-detail/`, `components/header/`, `components/footer/`), and squadB's "9 paths, zero exist" is correct.

**6. `fedLead-playbook.md:446` / `uiBuild-knowledge.md:664` — "six weeks older than every other rules file"**
Actual last-commit dates: `squadA.md`/`squadB.md` = 2026-07-14; `conventions.md` and `typescript.md` = **2026-07-10**, four days *older*. "~6 weeks behind the actively-maintained files" would be defensible; "older than every other rules file" is false.

**7. `fedLead-playbook.md:541` — "`runStoryTests.sh:13-16`"**
Lines 12-16 are a **prose comment**; the executable `grep -oE 'SFCC-[0-9]+'` is at **line 43**. Also `computeMrtPreviewSlug.mjs` has a second occurrence at `:55` alongside the cited `:47`, so the "three places that must stay in sync" is really four executable sites across three files.

**8. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:117` — "removed — 245 lines, 53 references across 8 files"**
The `241 lines` (at `7fcb5b5`) and `245 lines` (deletion diffstat) are both correct. "53 references across 8 files" reproduces nowhere: at the removal commit's parent (`50c7b74`) `cssVars` had **10** consumer files and **148** occurrences (124 dotted usages); peak in history was 10 files. And at the actual delete commits `78f2236`/`e7e8c0c`, consumers were already **zero**.

**9. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:501` — "Four call sites, three paths"**
Actual: `useContentfulEntries`/`useContentfulEntry` have **3 invocation sites across 2 production files** (`uiCopyProvider/index.tsx:19`, `pages/home/index.tsx:148` and `:175`). Related over-reach in the same sentence: "all eight storefronts get the space default" is true of `useContentful.ts` and the footer, but `pages/experience/index.tsx:95` and `pages/contentfulPreview/index.tsx:136` **do** pass `localeCode`.

**10. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:673` — "(zero MSW references, and `AGENTS.md` bans mocking)"**
`msw@1.3.5` **is** installed (transitively via `@salesforce/retail-react-app`; 0 references in `overrides/` source, but 7 files outside `node_modules` mention it). More seriously, AGENTS.md does **not** ban mocking outright — it says "No MSW or hardcoded fixtures **in production paths**", and `.claude/rules/testing.md` explicitly permits MSW for cross-functional integration tests. The underlying point about `architecture.md:95` is still valid, just for a different reason (MSW is a test tool described as the local-dev data source).

**11. `fedLead-playbook.md:500` — `lighthouse-ci` "needs `LHCI_*` secrets that don't exist"**
The failure cause is wrong: `lighthouserc.js:4` and `:18` fall back to `http://localhost:3000` / `temporary-public-storage` when those env vars are empty, and the job has no server-start step — so it fails collecting against a dead localhost, not on a missing secret. Also "two of its **four** jobs": `digital-sit.yml` has **6** jobs; 4 is only `sit-gate`'s `needs:` list. The "zero `*.p0.spec` files, no `passWithNoTests`" half is correct (p0 selection is `--project=p0` via `playwright.config.js:53-54`, not a grep).

## IMPRECISE — substance right, citation or scope wrong

**12. `fedBuild-manual.md:355,367,504` / `uiBuild-knowledge.md:622,624` — `testing.md:87` and `testing.md:100`**
Actual: `@storybook/test` is at **`testing.md:115`** (line 87 is `### Commerce SDK hooks`); "never reach into `document`" is at **`testing.md:128`** (line 100 is blank). A uniform **+28** offset — written against a copy predating the `ZimmIcon`/Vitest block. Both statements exist and say what's claimed, and the no-portal-carve-out finding holds (`grep -i portal testing.md` → 0).

**13. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:63` — "`header/index.tsx:302` has `fontSize="l"`"**
Actual line **311**. Line 302 is an `onMouseLeave` handler. The violation is real and is the only `fontSize=` in the file.

**14. `fedLead-playbook.md:615` — Consent "Implemented as a 5-second timeout"**
There is **zero Didomi code** anywhere under `overrides/`. The 5-second timeout is a *documented decision* in `.docs/integration/12-didomi.md:102-103`. The same playbook lists Didomi as "Doc-only" 40 lines earlier — internally contradictory.

**15. `fedLead-playbook.md:486` / `fedBuild-manual.md:372` — preview deploys on "every `feature/**`/`fix/**` push"**
`deploy-preview.yml:16,21` explicitly excludes `fix/release-*` and `fix/release/**`.

**16. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:463` — `environment-template.d.ts:30-33`**
The `entities` block is at **31-34** (slots at 32-33); line 30 is `versionDescription?`. Path (`dist/types/…`) is correct and the substantive claim — no `entries` slot — holds.

**17. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:674` — "`config/contentfulMapping.ts:53`"**
Actual path is **`overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.ts`**. A real, different top-level `config/` exists and is one of the four Tier 1 absolutes, so the shorthand points at the wrong governance tier. Line 53, "zero consumers", and "duplicates `content-types/*.js`" are all correct.

**18. `fedBuild-manual.md:633` — "enforced by `bundlesize`"**
Budgets (180 kB / 550 kB at `package.json:100-109`) are correct; the tool is **`bundlesize2@0.0.35`**, a transitive dep of retail-react-app. `bundlesize` itself is not installed.

**19. `uiBuild-knowledge.md:661` — `tag-sprint` "The job has never fired"**
The job runs on every dev deploy; it's a guarded permanent no-op (`deploy-dev.yml:105` sets `changed=false`, and the tag step is `if: changed == 'true'`). The *tag* has never been created. "Never fired" reads as broken when it's inert-by-design.

**20. `fedLead-playbook.md:676` — "`bootstrapSpace.mjs:238-240` has the correct pattern"**
238-240 is the explanatory comment; the pattern code is **241-247**. (The main claim — `promoteAlias.mjs:70` calls `environmentAlias.createOrUpdate`, which has **0 occurrences** in `contentful-management@12.3.2`, whose real surface is `get/getMany/createWithId/update/delete` — is fully correct.)

**21. `fedLead-playbook.md:269` — "`Playwright E2E` and `Cross-browser E2E`"**
Full check names are `Playwright E2E (localhost)` and `Cross-browser E2E (BrowserStack)`. A required-check rule matches the full name, so the truncated strings would match nothing.

**22. `fedLead-playbook.md:171` / `fedBuild-manual.md:98` / `uiBuild-knowledge.md:260` — "`generateRegistry.mjs:122`"**
Line 122 is a section-comment banner; `TIER1_PATHS` starts at 125 and `getTier()` at 199-203. Substance verified true: hardcoded arrays, no `ui-kits` path, default `'4 — Feature-local'`.

**23. `fedBuild-manual.md:455` / `uiBuild-knowledge.md:494` — "`include: 3`"**
Footer-specific (`footer/index.tsx:27`). `useContentful.ts:47` and `:110` hardcode `include=2`; the footer's own comment at `:25-26` says this explicitly. Misleading if read as the app's fetch depth.

## UNVERIFIABLE

**24. `fedLead-playbook.md:33` / `fedBuild-manual.md:72` — "SOW allows 10 defects, no Sev3"** — nothing in `.docs/` supports it; no SOW document, defect budget, or severity taxonomy exists in the repo. Not contradicted, just unsourced.

**25. `fedLead-playbook.md:572` — "2 live, 5 partially wired, 11 doc-only"** — the 18 total is correct (`.docs/integration/` holds exactly 18 `NN-*.md`). The 5/11 split doesn't reproduce: counting `overrides/` references gives ~7 with some code presence and 9 with none, and four of the seven are a single mention inside the *dead* `connectionPools.ts`. It's a judgement, not a count.

**26. All GitHub-server claims** (branch protection, required checks, team membership counts, `prod`/`staging`/`uat` protection rules, PR #59's check states, tag ruleset bypass, `CODERABBIT_API_KEY` as a plaintext variable, Contentful per-tier type/entry counts) — not checkable without network calls, which were out of scope.

---

## Categories with no defects found

Every item on your load-bearing list checked out, and I confirmed each claimed breakage really is broken:

- **`var(--zimm-*)` required in JSX, bare token strings not** — `overrideStyling.md` hierarchy point 2 and `css.md` both state it; the two claimed live violations are real at the exact lines cited (`zimmProductName/index.tsx:20`, `zimmProductModelInfo/index.tsx:23`).
- **a11y IS gated** — `@storybook/test-runner@0.24.4`'s `dist/setup-page-script.js:390-397` reads `story.parameters?.a11y?.test` and throws on `"error"`; `.storybook/preview.tsx:44` sets exactly that. Line numbers exact.
- **`@storybook/test` not installed; `storybook/test` is right** — no such directory; `storybook@10.4.6`'s `package.json:206` exports `"./test"`.
- **CODEOWNERS** — no catch-all rule (zero `*`-only lines in 190); `babel.config.js`/`tsconfig.json`/`theme/globalStyles.ts` all absent; `:162` assigns `pages/product-detail/` to `@ZimmermannAU/pwa-squad-b`; `:186` is genuinely the last `components/` rule.
- **Eleven overridden directories** — exact list match.
- **`theme/components/button.ts` gone** — directory holds only `footerShared.ts`, `header.ts`, `index.ts`, `listMenu.ts`, `navConstants.ts`, `recipeGuards.test.ts`.
- **`audit:tokens`** — exists, wired, and reports exactly **19** unacknowledged violations, splitting **14 pre-existing + 5 in `product-view/index.tsx`** as claimed.
- **`promoteAlias.mjs:70`** — verified, including the 0-occurrence grep.

Also spot-checked and correct: 22 textStyles; 15 numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases with exactly the 7 named ones hardcoded (so `theme/index.ts:47`'s comment really is wrong and `overrideStyling.md:83-85` really is right); `space` the only registered scale; `BTN_HEIGHT_LG/SM/PADDING_Y` = 50/41/5px vs `actionSizes` 52/40px; primary-button hover contrast computes to exactly **2.96:1** (`#969696` on white); `BP.desktop` 64em vs Chakra `lg` 62em; `INTENTIONAL_MERGES = ['Button','Header','ListMenu']`; zero `.scss` files; zero page stories; `shared/ui/index.jsx:29`; `footerNavColumn/index.tsx:44,62`; PR #59 = 93 commits with `footer/index.tsx` touched 32 times across Aug 17-21; eight storefronts / eleven locale slots (config has 11 site entries, reconciling to 8 business storefronts as `testing.md` describes); `test:lighthouse` dead path at `package.json:57` and `AGENTS.md:37`; `npm run lint` exits 1 on 17 pre-existing prettier errors; `test:contracts` is `echo … && exit 0` and gates `sit-gate`; `connectionPools.ts` dead; `ssr.*` CI glob blind to `ssr/**`; `sprintScope.md` two months stale and cited by exactly 6 skills.

No files were modified, and no network calls or `scripts/contentful/` executions were made.
